claim: Production-safe chain validated end-to-end: CompositeRouter on denoising hit the freshly-promoted family default (opus-4-8-all, via E031 family update) without firing the LLM bridge, ran a complete pipeline, and produced GOLD score 0.01217 at $11.26. This is n=4 for denoising-opus-all gold (X205 $10.59, E-PN1 $10.67, E-PN4-denoising $9.20, E-PN11 $11.26; mean $10.43, range $2.06). The Static → LLM-fallback chain works in production. Combined with E035's policy.json fix and E037's known_overrides bug fix, the routing infrastructure is now: (a) Policy + family layer correct for tested tasks; (b) Composite returns the right routing without LLM cost; (c) LLM fallback fires only on truly novel tasks. The autonomous loop has validated the entire stack.
